messages:
samira: 09:12 - alert: SLO burn spike on /generation endpoint, multiple burn-rate windows firing (1m/5m/1h). Seeing surge correlated with model-x serving new traffic. Paging now.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2102345678. Pager: alex-w. Severity: P2. Links: https://ops.redwood/incidents/INC-2102345678
alex-w: on it. can someone post error rates and top callers? @maria-s can you pull the query?
maria-s: grabbing stats... 5xx count up 4.3x in last 10m, token failure rate 0.9%. Most traffic from mobile-proxy service.
leo_k: I see a model fallback loop — model-x is returning timeouts at tail latencies and clients are retrying. KV cache hot keys on a small subset.
samira: suggests throttling mobile-proxy at 50r/s to reduce retries. can we gate retried requests?
alex-w: going to pause canary routing to model-x immediately. /deploy pause-routing model-x-canary
pagerbot: Routing pause command accepted. Canary traffic set to 0% for model-x-canary.
maria-s: After pause, 1m error rate trending down. SLO burn still high due to 1h window. Consider paging thresholds? current alert: burn_rate_5m > 0.25 OR burn_rate_1h > 0.1 -> page.
leo_k: I'd prefer multi-window logic: page only if (burn_5m > 0.25 AND burn_1h > 0.08) OR (burn_5m > 0.5). Otherwise send non-paging followup.
samira: agreed. paging during flapping is noisy. For this incident customer impact low (retryable), let's suppress paging while impact < 1% active user error.
alex-w: done manual mitigations: paused canary, applied per-model qps cap, and rolled model-x back to v1.4.
maria-s: rolling back reduced tail timeouts. Error rate -> 0.4x baseline. SLO burn 5m down to 0.02, 1h 0.06.
incident-bot: INC-2102345678 status -> mitigated by routing rollback and QPS caps.
samira: postmortem immediate actions: 1) adjust alert to multi-window gating; 2) create dashboard tile for model-level tail p99/p999 latencies; 3) add suppression rule for low-customer-impact models.
alex-w: can someone propose specific alert delta? I'd suggest updating alert expression to:

```
PAGE if (burn_5m > 0.25 AND burn_1h > 0.08) OR (burn_5m > 0.5)
ALERT (non-pager) if burn_1h > 0.08
```

and add label customer_impact = high/low based on active_error_rate > 0.5%.
maria-s: I'll open a runbook PR for the new alert logic and create a dashboard panel for model-level eviction metrics. tagging @leo_k for KV cache heatmap.
leo_k: will add a cache keys heatmap and top prefixes. also recommend adding a short token-decay cache to reduce hot-key pressure.
samira: decision log: keep SLO burn alert sensitivity but reduce pager noise by requiring cross-window confirmation or very high short-window spikes. add 2-week monitor to see if we miss paging.
alex-w: assign followups: MAR-452 (alert rule change), MAR-453 (dashboard), MAR-454 (runbook updates). I'll take MAR-452.
maria-s: I'll handle MAR-453 and MAR-454.
incident-bot: Follow-ups created: MAR-452, MAR-453, MAR-454. Next postmortem meeting scheduled 11:00 tomorrow.
samira: quick note — we should add a tag to SLO alerts to exclude non-client-facing internal model tests.
leo_k: ack. also let's add a synthetic canary to detect KV hot keys earlier.
alex-w: thanks all. closing loop here, will update incident doc. :white_check_mark:
